mapper.select: select board_id, like_cnt, title, view_cnt, created_at, comment_cnt, name as author from ( select b.board_id, b.title, b.created_at, b.member_id, b.view_cnt, COUNT(distinct c.comment_id) as comment_cnt, count(distinct l.like_id) as like_cnt from board b left join comments c on b.board_id = c.board_id left join likes l on b.board_id = l.board_id group by b.board_id, b.title, b.created_at, b.member_id, b.view_cnt ) t, membertbl m where t.member_id = m.id order by t.created_at desc
select board_id, title, content, member_id, name, created_at from board join membertbl on board.member_id = membertbl.id where board_id = #{board_id}
mapper.insert: insert into board ( title, content, member_id ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{content}, #{member_id} )
